00045 PopupComponent::PopupComponent(const int max) 
00046 : maxCount(max) 
00047 {
00048  activePopups++;
00049  startTimer(100);
00050 }
00051 
00052 PopupComponent::~PopupComponent()
00053 {
00054  activePopups--;
00055 }
00056 
00057 void PopupComponent::paint(Graphics &g)
00058 {
00059  g.setColour(Colour::greyLevel(0.5).withAlpha(0.75f));
00060  g.fillRoundedRectangle(0, 0, getWidth(), getHeight(), 5);
00061 } 
00062 
00063 void PopupComponent::mouseDown(MouseEvent const& e)
00064 {
00065  resetCounter();
00066 } 
00067 
00068 void PopupComponent::resetCounter()
00069 {
00070  counter = maxCount;
00071 }
00072 
00073 void PopupComponent::timerCallback()
00074 {
00075  if(Component::getNumCurrentlyModalComponents() > 0 && counter >= 0)
00076  {
00077   resetCounter();
00078  }
00079  else
00080  {
00081   counter--;  
00082   if(counter < 0)
00083   {
00084    stopTimer();
00085    delete this;
00086   }
00087  }
00088 }
00089 
00090 void PopupComponent::expire()
00091 {
00092  counter = -1;
00093 }

00095 int PopupComponent::activePopups = 0;
